## Highlights

- **Share a database as a web studio.** Anyone with the link opens it in the browser at stroke.click, end-to-end encrypted. Everyone sees each other's cursors on the grid, and the shared console is one SQL tab you all type into at once.
- **AI agents can show you data.** `npx strokedb mcp` gives Claude Code and other agents your tables, read-only, and a link that opens the one they mean.
- **New engines (beta):** Google Cloud Spanner, BigQuery, Snowflake, Neo4j, InfluxDB, YugabyteDB, AlloyDB, and any database with an ODBC driver.
- **Five languages:** Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Japanese.
- **Proxy settings** for app, AI, database and tunnel traffic, and tunnels through Kubernetes port-forward and AWS SSM besides SSH.
- **Large tables feel local.** A big table is copied to disk in the background, deep jumps land in a fraction of the time, and wide JSON or HTML rows show what's on screen first.
- **Your own fonts** for the interface, editor, grid, AI chat and terminal, plus SQL snippets, a display timezone, and export/import of your whole setup.
